level.communityText: People from the area confirmed that the statement is right.
level.selfText: The person says they are responsible. This is not checked.

confirm.button: That is right, I live here
confirm.notAffected: Only people from the place of the responsibility can confirm.

dispute.label: Who is responsible instead, or why is the statement wrong?
dispute.help: Both sides have {days} days for evidence. Then seven people from the region decide whether the statement is right. For official bodies the check of the email address decides.

flags.vacant: Vacant: no answer for more than {days} days. You can forward requests to other responsible people.
flags.noAnswer: No answer to a request for {days} days.
flags.unanswered: {n, plural, one {1 request} other {# requests}} marked unanswered

sent.empty: You have not asked any responsible person yet.

mine.state_pending_official: This title sounds like an office. It is only shown once you confirm it with an agency email.
mine.handOverText: Another person takes over the responsibility. They have to accept. The history stays visible.
mine.pending: Hand-over to {name} waits for an answer
mine.substituteText: One person answers requests while you are away.
mine.joinText: An official responsibility belongs to the office. Whoever has an email address of the same office can help run it.
mine.reconfirmDue: Has to be confirmed again by {date}.
mine.leaveConfirm: The responsibility stays with the others.
mine.transferTitle: {by} wants to hand “{title}” over to you
mine.substituting: You are a substitute for “{title}” until {date}.

dispute_page.title: Dispute about a responsibility
dispute_page.status_upheld: The statement was wrong: the responsibility is withdrawn.
dispute_page.juror: You are one of seven people who decide. Read both sides and vote to the best of your knowledge.
